array_index_order: [sample, x, y]; x = east, y = north; cell (i,j) centre = ((i+.5)dx, (j+.5)dx) in window metres
wind_convention: wind_dir_deg = direction the wind blows TOWARD, 0 = +y (north), 90 = +x (east). Meteorological 'from' = (dir + 180) % 360
wind_height: 20-ft wind. Corsica: given to ForeFire as is, CORSICA_NATIVE applies windReductionFactor 0.4 inside Rothermel. US/Farsite: sim multiplies by WAF 0.4 and passes mph (Farsite unit bug)
fuel_source: LANDFIRE LF2025 FBFM40 (data_real/us/landfire/socal_chaparral_LF2025_FBFM40.tif) on AWS Terrain Tiles elevation
channels: 1 if the fuel class can burn, else 0
dead fuel load (kg/m2): Corsica Sigmad; US 1h+10h+100h
live fuel load (kg/m2): US herb+woody; 0 for Corsica (its Rothermel ignores live fuel)
time of the shift as a fraction of the horizon (constant plane)
1 inside the initial burning area (point = its one cell), else 0
0 = Corsica classic Rothermel, 1 = Farsite (US); constant plane

config.name: ember_init_v2
config._comment: Every range here is a team decision. Defaults span ForeFire's valid ranges or reuse values already in the harness; change them here, never in code. Corsica settings are identical to configs/init_corsica.json, so its rows equal ember_init_v1 apart from the sample_id prefix. US = six LANDFIRE sites (group 'us'); one whole site is held out as unseen terrain (test_ood).
config._grid_comment: Reference grid only. Samples are in absolute landscape metres; the labeller may use any grid.

ranges._comment: md spans up to the highest S&B extinction (40%) but is rescaled per sample to stay below the extinction moisture of the ignition fuel (md_below_extinction). 10-h = 1-h + offset, 100-h = 10-h + offset.

us_holdout_site._comment: team decision: which US site is never trained on

config._wind_comment: Wind turns by wind_shift_deg starting at wind_shift_t_frac*horizon, linearly over wind_shift_ramp_s (60 s steps), like a frontal/sea-breeze passage.

landscape.fuel_source: LANDFIRE LF2025 FBFM40 (data_real/us/landfire/socal_chaparral_LF2025_FBFM40.tif) on AWS Terrain Tiles elevation

fixed._comment: live moisture is NOT sampled: ForeFire's Corsica Rothermel ignores live fuel, so it cannot vary in both regions. US runs use ForeFire's own defaults (DataBroker.cpp).
